msg: So in my game there were 4 different gnomes to choose from. I chose the ones with the bigger hats (for me it was the red hat and brown hat gnomes) and they seemed to give the best amount of mushrooms. But sometimes every now and then they would give low amounts (like 0 - 2) and i would alternate between the smaller hats for a bit and they seemed to give me more for a short period. And then I would go back to the big hats for a while when the smaller hats gave me less. Usually it's better to pick the bigger hats I found in general, but do try to alternate when mushrooms get low for a little bit. Also I found that maybe spamming the keys gives less, so try and only press the S and K and spacebar once per round. It seems a bit random to be honest but I did find some success in my method.
